race.comment: THE MINSTREL BOY (2) sets the standard after putting away To'o by just over two lengths in a Maiden at this track as favourite on soft ground. He is lightly raced and Andrew Mallyon stays aboard. Has the profile to continue the winning momentum. MONTE CARLO MISS (10) is the main danger after returning from a let-up with a battling sixth over 1200m at the Gold Coast. Proven at the trip and expect to see her a bit closer in the run. GODTFRED KIRK (1) was only beaten just over two lengths at Eagle Farm in heavy ground and finished third in a Class 2 before that. Best form keeps him in the contest. DENVER BRONCO (5) is a dominant Gatton Mdn winner who gets weight relief third-up. Can give this a shake.
